Acquired 2025-03-01, placed in service 2026-04-15: bonus rate 100% (OBBBA 168(k): 100% for property acquired after January 19, 2025 (permanent)). On $150,000 of basis after Section 179 the special depreciation allowance is $150,000, leaving $0 for regular MACRS. First-year Section 179 plus bonus: $250,000.

This is an estimate, not tax advice. Check Form 4562, its instructions and Pub. 946, or ask a tax professional before you file.
